purpose: Teach: パーカー/出前/おとり/真っ青/ガット/月々/街路/ソープ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、パーカー、絶対、なんて、絶対、洋服、絶対、なかったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, your father really never wore hoodies or anything like that, did he? You remember?
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft gaze backward in time. Conversational rhythm — not rushed. The affectionate correction of someone who lived through it too.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、出前、絶対、お蕎麦、絶対、よく、絶対、頼んだわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: That's right. When I was young, your grandfather used to order soba delivery quite often, didn't he? You remember, don't you?
lines.style: Warm, engaged confirmation. Eyes lighting up at the shared memory. Slightly quicker than Hiroshi — she's eager to add her own thread to the story.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、警察の、絶対、おとり、絶対、捜査、絶対、お父さん、絶対、新聞で、絶対、よく、絶対、読んだぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your father used to read about police sting operations in the newspapers all the time, remember? Really used to read them.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective than the first line. Slight wonder in the delivery — the specific detail pulling him back. Pause before 'remember?' like he's checking if she caught that detail too.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、お料理の失敗で、絶対、真っ青、絶対、になっていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, your grandfather would turn absolutely pale whenever I made a cooking mistake, didn't he? You remember that?
lines.style: Light teasing lilt — she's enjoying catching him in this memory. Warm amusement underneath. Playful, not mean. The kind of gentle ribbing that only works after fifty years.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ガット、絶対、を張り替える、絶対、職人さん、絶対、よく、絶対、頼んだぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your father was always having that craftsman come fix the guitar strings, wasn't he? You remember that, gran?
lines.style: Slower than before, almost dreamlike. A specific image — the ritual of it. Soft insistence, like he's painting the picture for her. Reverential without being heavy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、家計、絶対、月々、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、相談したわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, we used to sit down every month and talk about our household finances with your grandfather, didn't we? You remember?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. The practicality of their partnership coming through. Not sentimental, but deeply certain. The comfort of routines built together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、街路、絶対、樹、絶対、町に、絶対、植えられたぞ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, they planted street trees all over town, didn't they? Gran, you remember that?
lines.style: Quieter, almost marveling. Like he's suddenly aware of a whole layer of the past they shared. Soft wonder. Trailing slightly — inviting her into this particular memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、お風呂で、絶対、固形ソープ、絶対、使っていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, your grandfather used to use bar soap in the bath, didn't he? You remember, don't you?
lines.style: Tender, intimate closure. The smallest detail — bar soap — held with the same care as bigger memories. Knowing smile in the voice. Close, like she's leaning in to tell him something precious.
